text:
Anya Lopez: rough plan for the launch newsletter + 3-email micro-nurture for signups from the benchmark post. main asks: geo send windows, dynamic subject personalization, and a replay routing for non-registrants.
Jonas Richter: agree. propose split: US/CA send Wed 10am PT, EMEA send Thu 10am CET, APAC send Mon 10am HKT. keeps local open cadence.
Oliver Grant: deliverability flag 1: run seed list + ISP check 24h before each region send. also suppress ActiveCustomers group so we don't email existing paid customers.
Nida Rahman: for personalization: subject token options are: "{{first_name}}, benchmark shows 3x cost savings" or fallback "New inference benchmark + webinar". we should test both.
Evan Brooks: can we do subject A/B by engagement tier? high-engagement gets the first name token, low-engagement gets the generic. reduces personalization noise.
Anya Lopez: good call. also want to test hero creative: chart snapshot vs human photo. we'll A/B that across segments.
Jonas Richter: segmentation details: inbound_path=benchmark_blog OR utm_campaign=bench_launch => register_invite. high_intent = visited=/benchmarks/docs OR clicked=bench_cta. capture via webhook and tag with "bench_inbound".
Oliver Grant: webhook schema example for tagging: ```lead_id={{id}}, tags=[bench_inbound], src=benchmark_post``` (ops-bot will post the exact payload in ESP).
ops-bot: Reminder: Seeds & ISP tests scheduled 2025-04-01T09:00:00Z and 2025-04-02T09:00:00Z.
Nida Rahman: copy needs: 1) 50-char subject, 2) 100-char preheader, 3) ~45-word hero paragraph, 4) 2 quick CTA labels (Register / Read the post). I can draft by Tue EOD.
Evan Brooks: analytics asks: track cohort by source (organic/paid/dev-forum), subject variant, and creative. report opens -> register -> replay conversion. dashboard owner?
Jonas Richter: I'll own dashboard. will add realtime widgets for register velocity and replay views.
Anya Lopez: routing logic for replay: if registrant misses live, send immediate replay + short summary 30min after webinar ends; if non-registrant clicked post but didn't register, include a "Quick Replay" CTA in nurture step 2.
Oliver Grant: ops: we should add a 5-minute canary for each regional send (10% audience) and monitor bounce rate > 1% to pause. also set ESP retry policy for failed webhooks to 3 attempts.
Nida Rahman: localization: dates/CTAs localized for EMEA/APAC and translate subject into JP/FR/DE for APAC/EMEA top locales. Priya (not in thread) will localize creative.
Evan Brooks: suppression lists: do not email anyone with status unsubscribed OR bounced_last_90d. also exclude anyone in "partner_trials" list.
Anya Lopez: timeline: seeds + final QA Mon; copy + assets Tue; segment export Wed 6am PT; US send Wed 10am PT; EMEA Thu 10am CET; APAC Mon 10am HKT. packagers: Jonas (dashboard), Nida (copy), Oliver (ops), Anya (launch owner).
Jonas Richter: exporting segments CSV: will include columns: email, first_name, region, source, last_activity, tag_list. will push to shared drive and notify ops.
Oliver Grant: I'll wire the ESP to read the CSV and apply dynamic content blocks based on region/token presence. also confirm seed addresses are in the ESP test list.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Benchmark launch newsletter + nurture" 2025-04-02T10:00:00-07:00. Invite: #marketing #growth #eng.
Nida Rahman: subjects I'm proposing to draft: (A) "{{first_name}} see our inference benchmark results" (B) "New: inference benchmark + webinar" (C) "Replay available: benchmark demo + tips". we'll A/B A vs B, hold C for nurture.
Evan Brooks: quick note on measurement windows: use 72h for open->register and 14d for replay engagement. set attribution to first-click on email.
Anya Lopez: final deliverable checklist: copy in doc, two hero images, seed list, segment CSV, dashboard link, ESP schedule. please drop artifacts in the shared folder by Tue 11:59pm PT.
Jonas Richter: will post dashboard link after setup.
Oliver Grant: will confirm canary + retry configs after segment upload.
Nida Rahman: posting draft copy by Tue morning for review.
Anya Lopez: thanks team 32; let's keep threads short tomorrow during QA window. :rocket:
